items.source: Configure a specific BeanNameGenerator to be used when creating the repository beans.
items.translation: 配置一个特定的 BeanNameGenerator，以便在创建存储库 Bean 时使用。

items.source: Configures the QueryEnhancerSelector to select a query enhancer for query introspection and transformation.
items.translation: 配置 QueryEnhancerSelector 以选择用于查询内省和转换的查询增强器。

items.source: Base packages to scan for annotated components.
items.translation: 用于扫描已注解组件的基础包。

items.source:
Configures whether nested repository-interfaces (e.g. defined as inner classes) should be discovered by the
repository infrastructure.
items.translation: 配置是否由仓库基础设施发现嵌套的仓库接口（例如定义为内部类的接口）。

items.source:
Configures what character is used to escape the wildcards _ and % in derived queries with
contains, startsWith or endsWith clauses.
items.translation: 配置在包含 contains、startsWith 或 endsWith 子句的派生查询中，用于转义通配符 _ 和 % 的字符。

items.source: Specifies which types are not eligible for component scanning.
items.translation: 指定不适用于组件扫描的类型。

items.source: Configure the repository base class to be used to create repository proxies for this particular configuration.
items.translation: 配置用于为当前特定配置创建存储库代理的存储库基类。

items.source: Supports ${…} placeholders which are resolved against the Environment as well as Ant-style package patterns — for example, "org.example.**".
items.translation: 支持 `${…}` 占位符，这些占位符将针对 Environment 进行解析，同时也支持 Ant 风格的包模式——例如 `"org.example.**"`。

items.source: Multiple packages or patterns may be specified, either separately or within a single String — for example, {"org.example.config", "org.example.service.**"} or "org.example.config, org.example.service.**".
items.translation: 可以指定多个包或模式，既可以分别指定，也可以在一个 `String` 中指定——例如 `{"org.example.config", "org.example.service.**"}` 或 `"org.example.config, org.example.service.**"`。

items.translation: value() 是该属性的别名，且两者互斥。

items.source: Use basePackageClasses() for a type-safe alternative to String-based package names.
items.translation: 使用basePackageClasses()作为基于字符串的包名的类型安全替代方案。

items.source: Configures when the repositories are initialized in the bootstrap lifecycle. BootstrapMode.DEFAULT (default) means eager initialization except all repository interfaces annotated with Lazy, BootstrapMode.LAZY means lazy by default including injection of lazy-initialization proxies into client beans so that those can be instantiated but will only trigger the initialization upon first repository usage (i.e a method invocation on it). This means repositories can still be uninitialized when the application context has completed its bootstrap. BootstrapMode.DEFERRED is fundamentally the same as BootstrapMode.LAZY, but triggers repository initialization when the application context finishes its bootstrap.
items.translation: 配置在引导生命周期中初始化存储库的时机。BootstrapMode.DEFAULT（默认值）表示急切初始化，但所有带有 Lazy 注解的存储库接口除外；BootstrapMode.LAZY 表示默认惰性初始化，包括向客户端 Bean 注入惰性初始化代理，以便这些 Bean 可以被实例化，但仅在首次使用存储库（即调用其上的方法）时才会触发初始化。这意味着即使应用程序上下文已完成引导，存储库仍可能处于未初始化状态。BootstrapMode.DEFERRED 在本质上与 BootstrapMode.LAZY 相同，但会在应用程序上下文完成引导时触发存储库初始化。

items.source: Alias for the basePackages() attribute. Allows for more concise annotation declarations e.g.: @EnableJpaRepositories("org.my.pkg") instead of @EnableJpaRepositories(basePackages="org.my.pkg").
items.translation: `basePackages()` 属性的别名。允许使用更简洁的注解声明，例如：使用 `@EnableJpaRepositories("org.my.pkg")` 替代 `@EnableJpaRepositories(basePackages="org.my.pkg")`。

items.source: Returns the key of the QueryLookupStrategy to be used for lookup queries for query methods. Defaults to QueryLookupStrategy.Key.CREATE_IF_NOT_FOUND.
items.translation: 返回用于查询方法查找查询的 QueryLookupStrategy 的键。默认值为 QueryLookupStrategy.Key.CREATE_IF_NOT_FOUND。

items.source: Returns the FactoryBean class to be used for each repository instance. Defaults to JpaRepositoryFactoryBean.
items.translation: 返回用于每个存储库实例的 FactoryBean 类。默认值为 JpaRepositoryFactoryBean。

items.source: Configures the name of the PlatformTransactionManager bean definition to be used to create repositories discovered through this annotation. Defaults to transactionManager.
items.translation: 配置通过此注解发现的仓库所使用的PlatformTransactionManagerbean 定义的名称。默认值为transactionManager。

items.source: Type-safe alternative to basePackages() for specifying the packages to scan for annotated components.
items.translation: 用于指定要扫描以查找已注解组件的包的安全类型替代方案，替代basePackages()。

items.source: Returns the key of the QueryLookupStrategy to be used for lookup queries for query methods.
items.translation: 返回用于查询方法查找查询的QueryLookupStrategy的键。

items.source: Returns the FactoryBean class to be used for each repository instance.
items.translation: 返回用于每个存储库实例的 FactoryBean 类。

items.source: Configures the name of the PlatformTransactionManager bean definition to be used to create repositories discovered through this annotation.
items.translation: 配置通过此注解发现的仓库所使用的 PlatformTransactionManager BeanDefinition 的名称。

items.source: Alias for the basePackages() attribute.
items.translation: `basePackages()` 属性的别名。

items.source: Type-safe alternative to basePackages() for specifying the packages to scan for annotated components. The package of each class specified will be scanned. Consider creating a special no-op marker class or interface in each package that serves no purpose other than being referenced by this attribute.
items.translation: `basePackages()` 的安全类型替代方案，用于指定要扫描以查找已注解组件的包。将扫描每个指定类的包。建议在每个包中创建一个特殊的无操作标记类或接口，其唯一用途是被此属性引用。

items.source: Specifies which types are eligible for component scanning. Further narrows the set of candidate components from everything in basePackages() to everything in the base packages that matches the given filter or filters.
items.translation: 指定哪些类型有资格进行组件扫描。进一步将候选组件的范围从basePackages()中所有内容缩小到与给定过滤器或过滤器匹配的基础包中的所有内容。

items.source: Returns the postfix to be used when looking up custom repository implementations. Defaults to Impl. So for a repository named PersonRepository the corresponding implementation class will be looked up scanning for PersonRepositoryImpl.
items.translation: 返回用于查找自定义仓库实现的后缀，默认为"Impl"。因此，对于名为 `PersonRepository` 的仓库，系统将扫描以查找对应的实现类 `PersonRepositoryImpl`。

items.source: Configures the name of the EntityManagerFactory bean definition to be used to create repositories discovered through this annotation. Defaults to entityManagerFactory.
items.translation: 配置通过此注解发现的仓库所使用的EntityManagerFactoryBean 定义的名称。默认值为entityManagerFactory。

items.source: Configures the name of the EntityManagerFactory bean definition to be used to create repositories discovered through this annotation.
items.translation: 配置通过此注解发现的仓库所使用的EntityManagerFactoryBean 定义的名称。

items.source: Configures the location of where to find the Spring Data named queries properties file. Will default to META-INF/jpa-named-queries.properties.
items.translation: 配置查找 Spring Data 命名查询属性文件的位置。默认值为 `META-INF/jpa-named-queries.properties`。

items.source:
Annotation to enable JPA repositories. Will scan the package of the annotated configuration class for Spring Data
repositories by default.
items.translation: 启用 JPA 存储库的注解。默认情况下，该注解将扫描配置类所在包以查找 Spring Data 存储库。

items.source: Configures when the repositories are initialized in the bootstrap lifecycle.
items.translation: 配置在引导生命周期中初始化仓库的时机。

items.source: Configures whether to enable default transactions for Spring Data JPA repositories.
items.translation: 配置是否启用 Spring Data JPA 存储库的默认事务。

items.source: Specifies which types are eligible for component scanning.
items.translation: 指定哪些类型有资格进行组件扫描。

items.source: Configures the location of where to find the Spring Data named queries properties file.
items.translation: 配置查找 Spring Data 命名查询属性文件的位置。

items.source: Returns the postfix to be used when looking up custom repository implementations.
items.translation: 返回用于查找自定义仓库实现的后缀。

items.source:
Configures whether to enable default transactions for Spring Data JPA repositories. Defaults to true. If
disabled, repositories must be used behind a facade that's configuring transactions (e.g. using Spring's annotation
driven transaction facilities) or repository methods have to be used to demarcate transactions.
items.translation: 配置是否启用 Spring Data JPA 存储库的默认事务。默认为 true。如果禁用，则必须在配置了事务的面罩（例如使用 Spring 的基于注解的事务设施）之后使用存储库，或者必须使用存储库方法来界定事务。

items.translation: 使用 BeanNameGenerator 或基础 BeanNameGenerator 接口来指示上下文默认值。
